title: Persian Provinces
note: Whole picture is one map. Persepolis, Pasargadae, Farah and Bactra (Balkh) from Wikidata; Issus not used (site uncertain). The Farah dot is about 190 km from modern Farah, so it is a check place only; east of Persepolis only Bactra controls the fit, so expect errors there of 50 km or more.
